title: Closed-side ambient partition and module restriction test
statement:
Let $X$ be a Noetherian scheme, meaning locally Noetherian and quasi-compact [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-quasi-compact-scheme], let $i:Z\hookrightarrow X$ be a closed immersion and let $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ be its complementary open immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-weil-open-immersion]. Let $(t_\mu:T_\mu\hookrightarrow Z)_{\mu\in I}$ be a finite stratification with constructible locally closed images [def-constructible-stratification, def-weil-constructible-subset, def-weil-locally-closed-subset]. Then the original schemes $T_\mu$, with immersions $i\circ t_\mu$, together with $U$ and $j$, form a finite stratification of $X$ with constructible locally closed images. Every open subset of $X$ is retrocompact and quasi-compact; in particular $j$ is quasi-compact. Empty strata are permitted. No reduction of $Z$ or $T_\mu$ is required.

Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and use constant rings and actual module inverse images on small pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Let $P$ be an $A_X$-module sheaf and $N$ an $A_Z$-module sheaf equipped with isomorphisms $i_A^*P\cong N$ and $j_A^*P\cong0$. The canonical composition comparisons give natural $A_{T_\mu}$-linear isomorphisms
$$(i\circ t_\mu)_A^*P\cong(t_\mu)_A^*i_A^*P\cong(t_\mu)_A^*N.$$
If each $(t_\mu)_A^*N$ is locally constant with finite geometric module stalks [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf, def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk], this extended partition witnesses finite constructibility of $P$ [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]: the old strata have those restrictions and the additional stratum has the constant zero-module sheaf. For $X=\varnothing$, a single empty stratum may be retained.

Old item steps 1, 4 and 5, with the supplied closed restriction replacing the closed-image counit.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-noetherian-complementary-stratifications] to $T=X$, the closed immersion $i$, its complementary open immersion $j$ (so $j(U)=|X|\setminus i(Z)$) and the given finite stratification $(t_\mu:T_\mu\hookrightarrow Z)_{\mu\in I}$ of $Z$. Its second clause states that the family of actual composites $(i\circ t_\mu:T_\mu\hookrightarrow X)_{\mu\in I}$ together with $j:U\hookrightarrow X$ is a finite stratification of $X$ by constructible locally closed subschemes, with the original stratum schemes $T_\mu$ unchanged, $U$ with its given scheme structure, and empty strata or empty $U$ allowed. Its first clause states that every subset of $|X|$ is quasi-compact and that $j$ is a quasi-compact morphism. In particular, for opens $V,W\subseteq X$ the set $V\cap W$ is quasi-compact, so every open $V$ is retrocompact by the definition in [def-weil-constructible-subset]. The constructibility of the images of the $t_\mu$ in $Z$ is not needed for this.

Apply [lem-pur-proetale-module-pullback-composition] with $f=i$, $g=t_\mu$, and $\Lambda=A$. Its comparison uses precisely the canonical constant-section coefficient maps and gives $(i\circ t_\mu)_A^*P\cong(t_\mu)_A^*i_A^*P$, naturally and $A_{T_\mu}$-linearly. Applying the functor $(t_\mu)_A^*$ to the supplied isomorphism $i_A^*P\cong N$ and composing gives the displayed comparison with $(t_\mu)_A^*N$.

On each old stratum compose the comparison of step 2 with its given local constant-module trivializations. Isomorphisms induce inverse maps on the stalk colimits [def-weil-proetale-geometric-stalk], so the stalks remain finite. On $U$ use $j_A^*P\cong0$: the constant presheaf with value the zero module is already a sheaf (every compatible family has its unique zero amalgamation), hence its sheafification is the zero module sheaf. The identity cover makes it locally constant [def-weil-proetale-locally-constant-sheaf]; its geometric stalk is zero, since the pointed-neighbourhood diagram is nonempty and all its modules are zero. The partition of step 1 therefore satisfies [def-weil-proetale-constructible-sheaf]. It has $|I|+1\geq1$ strata. Empty strata impose no stalk conditions; for $X=\varnothing$ one may keep just its single empty stratum. No scheme was replaced by a reduction.

lean.statement: theorem sf_closed_partition_module_test {X Z U : Scheme.{u}} [IsLocallyNoetherian X] [CompactSpace X] (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (hji : Set.range j = (Set.range i)ᶜ) (S : FiniteLocallyClosedStratification Z) (hS : ∀ μ : Fin S.n, Topology.IsConstructible (S.stratum μ)) : (∀ V : Set X, IsOpen V → IsRetrocompact V ∧ IsCompact V) ∧ QuasiCompact j ∧ ∃ (R : Stratification X) (e : Fin (S.n + 1) ≃ Fin R.n), (∀ a : Fin (S.n + 1), (⟨R.domain (e a), R.immersion (e a)⟩ : Σ W : Scheme.{u}, W ⟶ X) = Fin.snoc (α := fun _ : Fin (S.n + 1) ↦ Σ W : Scheme.{u}, W ⟶ X) (fun μ : Fin S.n ↦ (⟨S.domain μ, S.immersion μ ≫ i⟩ : Σ W : Scheme.{u}, W ⟶ X)) (⟨U, j⟩ : Σ W : Scheme.{u}, W ⟶ X) a) ∧ ∀ (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (P : proEtaleRingModules X (proEtaleConstantRing X A)) (N : proEtaleRingModules Z (proEtaleConstantRing Z A)) (h : proEtaleConstantModulePullback i A P ≅ N) (hzero : IsZero (proEtaleConstantModulePullback j A P)), (∀ μ : Fin S.n, Nonempty (proEtaleConstantModulePullback (S.immersion μ ≫ i) A P ≅ proEtaleConstantModulePullback (S.immersion μ) A N)) ∧ Nonempty (proEtaleConstantModulePullback j A P ≅ proEtaleConstantModuleSheaf U A (0 : ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} A))) ∧ ((∀ μ : Fin S.n, IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheafOfUniverses.{u, u} (S.domain μ) A (proEtaleConstantModulePullback (S.immersion μ) A N) ∧ ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (y : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ S.domain μ), Finite (proEtaleGeometricModuleStalk y (proEtaleConstantRing (S.domain μ) A) (proEtaleConstantModulePullback (S.immersion μ) A N))) → (0 < R.n ∧ ∀ a : Fin R.n, IsLocallyConstantProEtaleModuleSheaf (R.domain a) A (proEtaleConstantModulePullback (R.immersion a) A P) ∧ ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (y : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ R.domain a), Finite (proEtaleGeometricModuleStalk y (proEtaleConstantRing (R.domain a) A) (proEtaleConstantModulePullback (R.immersion a) A P))) ∧ IsConstructibleProEtaleModuleSheaf X A P)
